page_title: NOR 1-4 FRA | Norway v France 26/06/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Michael Oliver is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+4' 1 - 4 Bradley Barcola sends a precise lofted pass into the box, Desire Doue (France) rises above the defenders to meet the ball and heads it straight into the right side of the goal. The score sheet now reads 1:4.
90+2' Theo Hernandez (France) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
90+1' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Fredrik Aursnes (Norway) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Jorgen Larsen (Norway) is adjudged offside.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kylian Mbappe trots off the pitch and is replaced by Jean-Philippe Mateta (France).
87' Substitution. Jules Kounde walks off the pitch and Malo Gusto (France) comes on as a substitute.
87' Fredrik Aursnes (Norway) pounces on a bouncing ball on the edge of the box, but sends his volley high over the bar.
84' Patrick Berg (Norway) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
83' The substitution has been made. Jens Hauge has replaced Andreas Schjelderup (Norway).
83' Here comes a substitution. Oscar Bobb (Norway) is given a rest as he is replaced by Antonio Nusa.
81' France work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
80' Half-chance! Bradley Barcola (France) plays a pass into the box, but Egil Selvik reacts well to snuff out the attack. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to France.
79' Patrick Berg (Norway) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dayot Upamecano leaves the pitch and Ibrahima Konate (France) comes on.
74' Today's referee Michael Oliver rightly decides to book Aurelien Tchouameni (France) for his harsh tackle.
73' Patrick Berg (Norway) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
72' Superb touch by Oscar Bobb (Norway) as he receives a precise pass inside the box. He finds the keeper prepared as he unleashes his shot to the left side of the goal. Wonderful save!
68' A cooling break is underway.
66' Stale Solbakken has decided to substitute Henrik Falchener and he is replaced by Sondre Langas (Norway).
66' Kylian Mbappe (France) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
66' Rayan Cherki (France) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
65' Guy Stephan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Bradley Barcola (France) replacing Ousmane Dembele.
65' Substitution. Michael Olise is replaced by Rayan Cherki (France).
65' Ousmane Dembele (France) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee blows his whistle, France are awarded a corner kick.
64' Kylian Mbappe (France) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
61' Maxence Lacroix (France) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
61' Leo Ostigard (Norway) is penalised for holding. Michael Oliver signals a set piece. France win a free kick.
58' Egil Selvik (Norway) is able to continue to play.
57' Egil Selvik (Norway) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
56' Kylian Mbappe (France) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.

55' The corner is slung over and Leo Ostigard (Norway) out jumps the defence inside the six-yard box, but the header skims off the top of his head and goes miles wide of the right post for a goal kick.
54' The referee awards a corner and Patrick Berg (Norway) goes over to take it.
52' Egil Selvik displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Kylian Mbappe (France) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
51' Jorgen Larsen (Norway) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
50' Jorgen Larsen (Norway) blows a huge chance to score! He sends the penalty to the right side of the goal, but it's not enough to beat Mike Maignan who easily stops the effort.
49' Jorgen Larsen (Norway) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
48' Theo Hernandez (France) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Norway are awarded a penalty. What an opportunity to score!
46' Half-time substitution. Kristian Thorstvedt (Norway) will not participate anymore and Morten Thorsby is coming on.
46' Stale Solbakken has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Marcus Pedersen (Norway) comes on the pitch for Fredrik Bjorkan.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Aurelien Tchouameni (France) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Norway.
45+1' Michael Olise (France) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Manu Kone (France), but Egil Selvik is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
43' Ousmane Dembele (France) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
43' Norway have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
42' Desire Doue (France) dribbles into the box, but Egil Selvik is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
40' Handball by Jules Kounde (France).
37' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Norway, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
36' A player from France pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. It's a free kick to Norway, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
35' Aurelien Tchouameni (France) cracks a volley from just outside the box, but his miskick goes skyward.
32' 1 - 3 Goal Ousmane Dembele (France)! Ousmane Dembele (France) was put through by Aurelien Tchouameni and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom left corner. 1:3.
31' Jorgen Larsen (Norway) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
29' Andreas Schjelderup (Norway) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
24' The referee blows for a cooling break.
24' Theo Hernandez (France) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
23' Desire Doue (France) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
23' Michael Olise (France) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
23' Ousmane Dembele (France) prepares to take a corner kick.
22' Michael Olise (France) takes the corner but it's cleared. It will be a corner kick for France.
21' 1 - 2 Goal! Andreas Schjelderup tees up Thelo Aasgaard (Norway) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom left corner. 1:2.
20' 0 - 2 Goal! Kylian Mbappe slips it to Ousmane Dembele (France) on the edge of the box and he finds the left side of the net with a great effort. The score is 0:2.
19' Thelo Aasgaard (Norway) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
17' Kylian Mbappe (France) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the left post. Egil Selvik is alert and denies him with a nice save.
16' Flag up against Ousmane Dembele (France). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
14' Jorgen Larsen (Norway) latches onto a brilliant cross and fires the ball towards goal, but his shot goes high over the crossbar.
14' Patrick Berg (Norway) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
13' It looks like Aurelien Tchouameni (France) saw red with that tackle. Michael Oliver won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Norway get a free kick.

13' Michael Olise (France) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
11' Kristian Thorstvedt (Norway) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Mike Maignan was alert and made a comfortable save.
10' Patrick Berg (Norway) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
8' Desire Doue (France) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Egil Selvik.
7' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Kylian Mbappe laid the ball off to Ousmane Dembele (France), who shot from close range into the left side of the goal, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
5' Desire Doue (France) gets a shot from distance but fails to generate enough power to beat the goalkeeper.
5' France take a short corner kick.
5' Desire Doue (France) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. France will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

4' Manu Kone (France) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!

1' Kylian Mbappe (France) suddenly has an opportunity to surge into the box after the opposition's defenders leave him in an ocean of space. He unleashes a decent shot towards the top of the net, but Egil Selvik pulls off a fabulous save to deflect the ball onto the crossbar.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Norway will kick-off.
Michael Oliver will officiate today.
